title: Integrative spatial profiling of 3D genome organization and gene expression in tissue
title_zh: 整合空间剖析3D基因组组织与组织内基因表达
abstract: Three-dimensional genome organization shapes transcriptional regulation, yet measuring its spatial coordination in situ within intact tissues remains challenging. We present Spatial Hi-C-RNA, a multimodal platform that simultaneously maps genome-wide chromatin contacts and transcriptomes from the same tissue section at near-single-cell resolution. Across the mouse brain, developing embryos, and human melanoma, Spatial Hi-C-RNA generated multimodal maps that aligned with tissue anatomy while revealing complementary chromatin- and RNA-defined spatial patterns. Multiscale features, including A/B compartments, topologically associating domains, and chromatin loops, were associated with region- and cell-type-specific transcriptional programs. In mouse embryos, Spatial Hi-C-RNA resolved coordinated chromatin and transcriptional remodeling during neuronal maturation across developmental stages. In human melanoma, chromatin architecture delineated intratumoral subregions not detected by RNA alone and linked tumor-state transitions to changes in compartments, domain boundaries, and regulatory programs. Spatial Hi-C-RNA thus provides a broadly applicable framework for investigating genome structure-function relationships in development and disease within native tissue environments.
abstract_zh: 三维基因组组织决定转录调控，但在完整组织内原位测量其空间协调仍具挑战性。我们提出 Spatial Hi‑C‑RNA，一种多模态平台，可在同一组织切片中近单细胞分辨率同时绘制全基因组染色质接触图和转录组。该方法在小鼠大脑、发育胚胎和人类黑色素瘤中生成的多模态图与组织解剖结构相符，并揭示了染色质与RNA定义的互补空间模式。多尺度特征，包括A/B区室、拓扑关联域和染色质环，与区域和细胞类型特异的转录程序相关联。在小鼠胚胎中，Spatial Hi‑C‑RNA 解析了神经元成熟过程中不同发育阶段的染色质与转录重塑的协调性。在人类黑色素瘤中，染色质结构划分了单纯通过RNA无法检测到的肿瘤内亚区，并将肿瘤状态转变与区室、域边界和调控程序的变化联系起来。Spatial Hi‑C‑RNA 因此为在天然组织环境中研究基因组结构-功能关系提供了广泛适用的框架。
